title: Volcanoes
question: Why does Tazieff risk his life like this?

meanings.usage: 指从事科学研究的人，可数名词
指一个人的整个生命时间
常用于描述正在运作的事物
指仔细观察并研究某事物
不及物动词，用于描述火山爆发
形容力量强大、破坏性的事物
可数名词，口语中常简称为 photo
指液态物质，与 solid（固体）和 gas（气体）相对
指从危险或困境中逃离
指用工具测量温度、大小等
指冷热程度，常与 measure 搭配使用
指从四面八方围住某物

examples.en: He has often risked his life in this way.
examples.zh: 他经常以这种方式冒着生命危险。

examples.en: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano.
examples.zh: 塔齐耶夫得以在离火山很近的地方搭建营地。

examples.en: Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
examples.zh: 塔齐耶夫设法及时逃脱了。

examples.en: He was able to return two days later.
examples.zh: 两天后他能够返回。

examples.en: He waited until the volcano became quiet.
examples.zh: 他等到火山安静下来。

examples.en: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
examples.zh: 塔齐耶夫经常以这种方式冒着生命危险。

examples.en: A river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
examples.zh: 一股熔岩正向他涌来。

examples.en: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
examples.zh: 他告诉我们的关于活火山的情况比任何在世的人都多。

examples.en: He managed to take a number of brilliant photographs.
examples.zh: 他设法拍摄了一些精彩的照片。

examples.en: He managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro.
examples.zh: 他设法爬进了基图罗火山口。

sentences.en: Haroun Tazieff, the Polish scientist, has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 波兰科学家哈伦·塔齐耶夫一生都在研究世界各地的活火山和深洞。

sentences.en: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano which he later named Kituro.
sentences.zh: 1948年，他去了刚果的基伍湖，观察一座新火山，他后来将其命名为基图罗。

sentences.en: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano while it was erupting violently.
sentences.zh: 塔齐耶夫在火山猛烈喷发时，能够把营地设在离火山很近的地方。

sentences.en: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs, he could not stay near the volcano for very long.
sentences.zh: 尽管他设法拍了许多精彩的照片，但他不能在火山附近待太久。

sentences.en: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
sentences.zh: 他注意到一条液态岩石的河流正向他涌来。

sentences.en: It threatened to surround him completely, but Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
sentences.zh: 它威胁要将他完全包围，但塔齐耶夫设法及时逃脱了。

sentences.en: He waited until the volcano became quiet and he was able to return two days later.
sentences.zh: 他等到火山平静下来，两天后才得以返回。

sentences.en: This time, he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures.
sentences.zh: 这次，他设法爬进了基图罗的火山口，以便拍照和测量温度。

sentences.en: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
sentences.zh: 塔齐耶夫经常以这种方式冒生命危险。

sentences.en: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
sentences.zh: 他比任何在世的人都能告诉我们更多关于活火山的信息。

exercises.explain: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive. — 他比任何在世的人都能告诉我们更多关于活火山的信息。

source.en: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.

exercises.prompt: “表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作” 描述的是哪个语法点？
options: 现在进行时态 (Present Continuous Tense)
too...to 和 more than + 情感动词
be made of 询问材质
exercises.explain: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)：主语 + was/were + 动词-ing：用于描述过去正在发生的动作，常与 when/while 等连用

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs, he could not stay near the volcano for very long.
options: 尽管他设法拍了许多精彩的照片，但他不能在火山附近待太久。
“灭火器，亲爱的，”大使干巴巴地回答道。
然后他笑了，告诉我每年将额外获得一千英镑！
exercises.explain: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs, he could not stay near the volcano for very long. — 尽管他设法拍了许多精彩的照片，但他不能在火山附近待太久。

source.en: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs, he could not stay near the volcano for very long.

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Simple Past Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态，通常与表示过去的时间状语连用
grammar.usage: 用于叙述过去发生的事情，描述已经完成的动作或状态

examples.en: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo.
examples.zh: 1948年，他去了刚果的基伍湖。

examples.en: He later named Kituro.
examples.zh: 后来他将其命名为基图罗。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去正在发生的动作，常与 when/while 等连用

examples.en: The volcano was erupting violently.
examples.zh: 火山正在猛烈喷发。

examples.en: A river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
examples.zh: 一股熔岩正向他涌来。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，即'过去的过去'
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于描述在过去的某个动作之前已经完成的动作

examples.en: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him, but he had already taken many photos.
examples.zh: 他注意到熔岩正向他涌来，但他已经拍了很多照片。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has spent + 时间/精力 + doing something

original.en: Haroun Tazieff has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes.
original.zh: 哈伦·塔齐耶夫一生都在研究活火山。

examples.en: She has spent her life teaching students.
examples.zh: 她一生都在教书育人。

examples.en: He has spent ten years writing this novel.
examples.zh: 他花了十年写这本小说。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + able to + 动词原形

original.en: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano.
original.zh: 塔齐耶夫得以在离火山很近的地方搭建营地。

examples.en: I was able to finish the work on time.
examples.zh: 我能够按时完成工作。

examples.en: She was able to speak three languages.
examples.zh: 她能说三种语言。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + managed to + 动词原形

original.en: Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
original.zh: 塔齐耶夫设法及时逃脱了。

examples.en: He managed to pass the exam.
examples.zh: 他设法通过了考试。

examples.en: We managed to find the way home.
examples.zh: 我们设法找到了回家的路。

patterns.pattern: It threatened to + 动词原形

original.en: It threatened to surround him completely.
original.zh: 它（熔岩）威胁要将他完全包围。

examples.en: The rain threatened to ruin our picnic.
examples.zh: 雨可能会毁掉我们的野餐。

examples.en: The storm threatened to destroy the town.
examples.zh: 暴风雨可能会摧毁这个城镇。
